title: The Beast from the Sea
description: John sees a beast rising out of the sea with ten horns and seven heads, with blasphemous names on its heads. It looks like a leopard, with feet like a bear's and a mouth like a lion's. The dragon gives it his power, throne, and great authority. One of its heads seems to have a fatal wound that is healed, and the whole earth follows in amazement after the beast and worships it. It speaks blasphemous words against God for forty-two months, makes war on the holy ones, and gains authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation. All whose names are not written in the Lamb's book of life worship it.
